item.title: Version 0.4.4
item.description: Splits that lose their other window go back to tabs for good, and no side of a split can be squeezed under 400 points; grids make room for apps with a minimum size. New: Groups page in Settings, tab and app colors with an App Colors page, Gather, group icons and auto names, drag to the screen edge to bubble, trackpad tick, group sharing, Your Week recap, Shortcuts actions and thecollector:// links, and Record mode (timed troubleshooting recordings) in Settings > Experimental.

item.title: Version 0.4.3
item.description: Peek now only moves your tabs. Every style keeps its own look, rests tucked behind the window with its top showing, and slides up when you point at it. Bookmarks rest as thin colored strips and have a new Corners setting.

item.title: Version 0.4.2
item.description: Debug log (Settings > Experimental, off by default): keeps the last 200 events in memory and writes them to ~/Library/Logs/The Collector/Debug.log only when something fails, plus a note on the next launch if the app did not quit normally. Window titles are left out of the file.

item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description: A tidier menu bar menu: Fit Groups to Screens, Ungroup All and the new Waiting Tabs list are under Groups, Export and Import are under Setup, and Welcome Tour, Open at Login and Check for Updates are under The Collector. Waiting Tabs shows tabs still waiting for their windows, and a click forgets one. Lighter on CPU: saving groups no longer asks every app for its titles, and waiting tabs are only looked for when something changed. Dragging a window by a Safari, Finder or Mail toolbar now groups it and moves its tabs. Browser colors are now off unless turned on in Settings, Experimental.

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
New: a Welcome Tour that walks through tabs, grids, bubbles and Peek on a practice desktop, then lets you pick a starter look. It opens on a fresh install and any time from the menu.

Tab clicks feel smoother: the clicked tab lights up right away, even when an app is slow to answer.

Experimental settings: live grid resizing and adaptive follow speed, both off by default.

The Bookmarks starter no longer says peek, since its tabs stay up.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
New: Saved Setups. Save your whole look under a name, switch between setups from the menu bar, and link one to your displays or to the laptop screen.

New: four built-in Starters in Settings, with pictures of how each one looks, to use as a starting point.

New: Peek. The tab bar can rest as thin colored slivers or icons and rise from behind the window when you reach for it.

New: Bookmarks, a slim deck of colored tabs along the window's edge.

New: Settings is now a sidebar window with Style, Peek, Bubbles, Mouse and Keyboard and Rules pages and a live preview. Each style remembers its own options.

Improved: choose where the tab bar sits along the window's edge, and tab bars now stay clear of the window's rounded corners.

Fixed: groups survive the lock screen, and closed windows leave their groups again.
